comment: The GHZ gate (the law's line by two hands, the mathematician's #1572 comment 5927559738 and the advisor's check 5927745013, at the owner's word: pass it to the advisor for approval, and implement it in the engine too if it works and entanglement like nature's is obtained; ALGEBRA.md #the-click-is-the-meeting, The GHZ gate; HIGHLIGHTS.md, One experiment and one gate): every number of the four worlds read by build_world.py, which writes the world files, their mode files (tools/pixel_mode.py, the message lay, with --modes) and the blind expectation file, derived from the settings and the patterns before any run by the reader's own algebra on equal parts (tools/bell_gate.py) and never touched after. One square board of `length` x `length` Nodes (z folded) on the universe file `universe` (examples/events/light.json with the GHZ family added, light's pair at the dimension [4, 1], four real lines laid as one event and never summed at a Node); the record laid as one event at the centre Node (`source`, `source`), three messages of the GHZ family at the wave `wave` (k = pi / 4, lambda = 8), one toward each side's face as `beams` lists them (the axis and the direction), with the raised-cosine edge `edge_along` along the beam and the flat top `top_across` with the edge `edge_across` across it, at the amplitude `amplitude`, every message laid on the four parts alike (the symmetric lay, Lattice.lay, the parts equal at every region at every interval by the determinism of Rule3, which the exactness rests on); one beam to each side, each to one declared region of `screen` Nodes deep along its beam and `top_across` wide across it, the board's last layer before its face, backed by the receding faces `receding` (opaque: what enters leaves the declared board and never returns; every face recedes, so no face layer reports); the side a's region `left`, the side b's `right` and the side c's `top`, each declaring its setting as its `basis` (p, q) and its `pattern`, one integer pair [alpha_k, beta_k] per part: the + port reads the part k as alpha_k p + beta_k q and the - port as alpha_k (-q) + beta_k p, the patterns A (p, p, q, q), B (p, q, p, q), C (p, -q, -q, -p), the even subsets of the three detectors; the four worlds the combinations (x, y, y), (y, x, y), (y, y, x) and (x, x, x) of the two `settings`, x the basis (1, 0) (the angle 0) and y the basis (1, 1) (the angle pi / 4), both rational and exact; `ticks` intervals, the reading over `window`, the whole passage. The reading (tools/bell_gate.py): the engine's `parts` lines, per interval and region the parts' signed level sums, paired through the root across the three sides and squared, the eight joint shares J over the window on both members of the level pair, E_3 per world by the product of the ports' signs, the three marginals and the three pairwise E, Mermin's M = E(x, y, y) + E(y, x, y) + E(y, y, x) - E(x, x, x) over the four, one triple of ports drawn by the shares with `seed`; beside it the three local credits as the fence (by the parts' shares, by the local sums and by the sign), from the same reports, and the parts' mismatch, LATTICE diagnostics never in the blind.
rule: the joint share accumulated over the window on both members of the level pair over the three sides: J(p_A, p_B, p_C) = SUM over the window of (SUM_k c_k now_k^A now_k^B now_k^C)^2 + (SUM_k c_k before_k^A before_k^B before_k^C)^2 with c_k = e_k(p_A) e_k(p_B) e_k(p_C), e_k(+) = alpha_k p + beta_k q by the side's declared pattern at its basis (p, q) and e_k(-) = alpha_k (-q) + beta_k p; E_3 = the eight shares signed by the product of the ports' signs over their sum, a marginal the side's + shares over the sum, a pairwise E the shares signed by two sides' signs over the sum; the window the whole passage, one triple per world drawn by the shares with the seed; J is a sum of squares and never negative, so no floor is needed (the mathematician, #1572 comment 5927559738; the advisor, 5927745013)

by_the_parts_shares.status: theorem: each part's share credited alone is a mixture over the parts of product forms, local realism, |M| at most 2; M = -1 at the gate's settings

by_the_local_sums.status: theorem: the product of the three sides' own squared sums is a product form, |M| at most 2; M = -1 at the gate's settings, where a reader rewritten as a local sum lands

by_the_sign.status: theorem: the larger port on each side, 0 at a tie, a product form, |M| at most 2; M = -1 at the gate's settings

blind.efficiency: 1, closed by construction: every triple is credited by the draw
blind.status: theorem under the owner's declaration of the credit, by two hands (the mathematician, #1572 comment 5927559738; the advisor, 5927745013): with the patterns A (p, p, q, q), B (p, q, p, q), C (p, -q, -q, -p) and (p, q) = (cos a, sin a), the credit SUM_k e_k(A) e_k(B) e_k(C) is cos(a + b + c) at an even number of - ports and sin(a + b + c) at an odd up to the sign, so the eight shares are cos^2(a + b + c) / 4 and sin^2(a + b + c) / 4 (the normalisation 4 at every setting), E_3 = cos 2(a + b + c), every marginal 1 / 2 and every pairwise E 0, M = -4 at x = 0 and y = pi / 4; the parts laid equal stepping equal by the determinism of Rule3; a gate of the engine and never a result (HIGHLIGHTS.md, One experiment and one gate)
